verdict.rationale: Angular is a client-side web framework and CLI toolchain, not a hosted service with an API or account system, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Angular running a credentialed service or a token system that would make the question applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
